rationale: The unit landing directly introduces its named concept or example before supplying the conditions. The table links each inherited operation to its actual defining unit, while the new completion condition links back to its opening definition. Code notation C → { fields } and struct(T) are accompanied by their definition links; n-step completion is described in prose and not reused as a theorem here.
limitations: Author editorial self-review; extraction and byte ranges do not themselves establish clarity or completeness. Unchanged chapters retain their previously examined reasoning after exact-input comparison; the destructor chapter was reviewed anew. Future notes remain nonnormative.
